objective: Auditer et terminer le diff de correction déjà présent pour la santé POS, la file hors-ligne, la supervision SLA, l'accessibilité POS/dashboard/borne et la fiabilité des preuves E2E POS-KDS-borne, sans modifier les invariants métier.
instruction: Le dépôt contient un diff partiellement implémenté par une exécution interrompue. Lis le plan actif, le task file et le diff git actuel comme état autoritaire. Vérifie chaque critère d'acceptation et chaque invariant, puis propose uniquement les correctifs encore nécessaires dans un objet JSON unique conforme à agents/codex.prompt.txt. Ne réécris pas ce qui est déjà correct. N'édite aucun fichier hors allowlist. Si un besoin touche prix, paiement, OrderStatus, OrderService, FrontendOrderService, migration, fiscal frozen ou Wheel, renvoie une ESCALATION sans l'implémenter.
acceptance: POS system health resolves the authenticated branch once, rejects branch_id <= 0, passes the exact branch to fiscal/stock/aging/outbox probes, and uses a branch-keyed fiscal cache.
Every failed or unavailable health probe, including Queue::size, reports unknown/degraded with an actionable message; cache get/put failures do not produce an HTTP 500 or a false green.

Unsigned legacy offline entries are quarantined and preserved, never POSTed from mount, timer, online event, or manual retry; signed/versioned entries have bounded attempts and distinguish terminal 4xx from network retry.
Playwright host/port is aligned with PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL unless an explicit command is supplied.

Wave E and every mutating kiosk harness require both FOODKING_E2E_DEDICATED_DB=1 and a test/e2e/playwright database identity before token creation, order placement or cleanup. Shared kiosk cleanup is non-destructive: its only write is an exact-branch cancellation through the canonical OrderService; the multi-product journey cancels all active synthetic-prefix orders through the POS API, fails on cleanup error, deactivates only synthetic catalog fixtures, invalidates only kiosk.menu.branch.{branchId}, proves kiosk machine/user identity unchanged and never deletes fiscal audit logs, nulls fiscal numbers or mutates OrderStatus directly.
SLA supervision exposes loading/error/stale/freshness, summary, oldest waiting item and a bounded priority list, with at most one request in flight.
Dashboard date presets, kiosk product activation and priority POS checkout controls use native keyboard semantics, accessible names and visible focus without nested interactive controls.
Pricing remains backend-authoritative; OrderStatus enum, strict branch isolation, after-commit dispatch and OrderService/FrontendOrderService symmetry remain unchanged.
gate_conditions: Wheel UX gate remains pending and out of scope.
Escalate before touching migrations, frozen fiscal services, pricing, payment, OrderStatus, OrderService or FrontendOrderService.
mandatory_tests: npx vitest run tests/js/posSystemHealthPill.spec.js tests/js/posOfflineQueueImpl.spec.js tests/js/usePosOfflineState.spec.js tests/js/slaAlertsSupervisor.spec.js tests/js/dashboardDatePresetAccessibility.spec.js tests/js/kioskProductCardKeyboard.spec.js tests/js/kioskIdleKeyboardStart.spec.js tests/js/posCheckoutAccessibilitySentinel.spec.js tests/js/kioskAuditCleanupSafety.spec.js tests/js/playwrightConfig.spec.js
self_audit_checklist: Allowlist strictly respected and current dirty work preserved.
No Wheel, migration, frozen fiscal service, pricing, payment or order service file changed.
No client-authoritative price logic or magic OrderStatus added.
Health probes and caches are exact-branch and fail closed.
Offline legacy payloads are preserved but cannot reach a POST.
E2E cleanup uses canonical APIs/services and never deletes immutable/fiscal evidence.
All mandatory tests are named; any impossible test is reported without inventing PASS.
